answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 4054 Country: India Title: Is it permissible to keep Hamsters as pets? If not please give reason? Question: Is it permissible to keep Hamsters as pets? If not please give reason? Answer ID: 4054 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 461/418=L) Yes, you can keep it as pet; there is no wrong in it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
